item.title: Concord University moved commencement ceremony due to weather
item.description: Mercer County, WV (WOAY) – Due to the weather forecast, Concord University is moving its commencement ceremony on Saturday to 1 p.m. The school says the delay gives staff more time to remove snow and let temperatures rise, creating a safer environment.
